text:
Type: black metal wall shelf with drawers
Use: holding keys, mail, plants and small things; hallway, entryway, kitchen, living room
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: black powder-coated steel frame, perforated mesh shelves, black drawer fronts with small knobs, metal hooks
Colors: matte black
Shape: tall open wall-hung frame with two slim upright loops above, two mesh shelves, a row of three drawers at the bottom, hooks underneath, light and graphic
Feel: graphic, practical, tidy, urban
Goes with: white walls, light wood, green plants, brass accents; industrial or modern entryways and kitchens

product.name: FALSTERBO
product.description: The shelves have a ledge to prevent whatever you place on it from sliding off.
